# Online-to-batch bounds for the one-pass runs (generated by online_bounds.py)

One pass of Adam over fresh minibatches of 64, 20000 steps, 3 seeds. 'Bound' is the certified upper bound on the average test error of the iterates in the window (prequential mistake rate + sqrt(ln(1/delta)/(2N)), delta = 0.025 per window); 'measured' is the average test error at the checkpoints inside the window. No capacity argument is used.
